## Validation methodology

IQ samples were generated using GNU Radio built-in blocks and numpy/scipy only.
The project's own blocks were NOT used to generate reference data.
This validation checks whether waveforms match expected modulation families and
orders using ONNX classifiers trained on public RF datasets.

## Notes

- Underlying modulation validated only for: DMR, M17, YSF, D-Star, NXDN, dPMR, P25
- Protocol framing and FEC not verified
- For gr-sleipnir: 8-carrier QPSK validated using custom plugin (carrier count, spacing, symbol rate, QPSK constellation checks)

### Excluded from validation (by design)

- Spread spectrum (DSSS, GDSS): designed to appear as noise; classifier output is not meaningful
- Cryptography modules (gr-nacl, gr-openssl, gr-linux-crypto): no RF modulation to validate
- Audio codecs (e.g. gr-opus): no RF modulation produced
- GNU Radio framework source trees (gnuradio, gnuradio4, gnuradio3): not OOT modules
